objective: Create scripts/runner/merge-decision.mjs exporting decideMergeAction(policy, checkRuns) returning 'merge-now', 'wait' or 'hold' for a coder-opened pull request. 'none' merges immediately; 'ci-gated' waits when no checks have reported or any is not completed, holds when any failed (failure, cancelled, timed_out, action_required, stale) or has an unrecognised conclusion, and merges when all are success, neutral or skipped; 'manual' and unknown policies hold. scripts/runner/merge-decision.test.mjs must pass.
